name: Uilora
summary: 700+ animation-first React, Next.js and React Native components, copy-paste ready.
description: A component library for web (Next.js App Router) and mobile (React Native / Expo): navigation and structure, forms, cards, modals, toasts, pricing/stats/testimonials/FAQ sections, hero and landing pages, backgrounds and motion pieces like scroll reveals, text animations and magnetic cursor, plus React Native UI, loaders and splash screens. Copy the TSX source or install via CLI; an MCP server lets AI editors browse and add components.
contains: 700+ components: 490+ web and 200+ mobile per the pricing page
web: navbars, mega menus, forms, modals, toasts, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, timelines, backgrounds
landing page sets: hero sections, auth pages, SaaS dashboards, agency/portfolio
React Native / Expo components: buttons, cards, loaders, toasts, splash screens
MCP server tools: listcomponents, viewcomponent, addcomponent (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf)
stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js
pricing: free tier plus Pro/Ultimate lifetime plans
